title: Classic Vanilla Cake
description: Indulge in our homemade vanilla cake, made with premium ingredients for a fluffy and moist cake, bursting with vanilla flavour. The smooth vanilla whipped cream frosting adds a touch of decadence. Order now for a slice of heaven.

title: Rich Chocolate Cake
description: Savour the luxurious taste of our rich and intense homemade chocolate cake sandwiched between layers of moist chocolate cream. This cake is one of our signature creations and a beloved choice for any celebration.

title: Pineapple Cream Cake
description: Indulge in a tropical feast for your taste buds with this delicious and refreshing dessert. The yellow cake base is light and fluffy, infused with juicy, sweet-tangy pineapple flavour. Every bite is layered with a rich and creamy pineapple cream filling, offering a burst of tropical sweetness in every spoonful.

title: Butterscotch Crunch Cake
description: Satisfy your sweet tooth with this mouth-watering, indulgent cake. A moist and fluffy vanilla sponge provides the perfect base for the rich and crunchy butterscotch topping made from the perfect blend of brown sugar and butter. Whipped cream adds a delicate creaminess to every bite, and the butterscotch is generously spread all over the cake and between the layers for a truly decadent treat.

title: Lychee Cream Cake
description: Treat yourself to the irresistible flavours of our Lychee Cream Cake. A moist vanilla sponge is the perfect canvas for a luscious lychee filling, creating a taste experience like no other. The juicy lychee fruit adds a sweet-tangy burst to every bite, perfectly complemented by the silky smooth whipping cream filling.

title: Chocolate Truffle Cake
description: Pamper yourself in the rich decadence of our dense, moist chocolate cake. Layers of the cake are paired with silky homemade chocolate truffle cream, creating a delectable contrast of textures. Simple in design yet full of flavour, this cake is a must-try for any chocolate lover.

title: Blueberry Cheesecake
description: Made with the finest cream cheese, this cheesecake boasts a smooth and indulgent texture. Topped with our signature blueberry compote, it offers the perfect balance of sweet and tart flavours. A true customer favourite, this cheesecake is a must-try for anyone looking for a delicious and satisfying dessert.

title: Nutella Cheesecake
description: Baked with the highest quality cream cheese, it has a delicious creamy texture and is topped with a generous portion of Nutella.

title: Rich Plum Cake
description: This cake is known for its moist texture and made with dried berries ,raisins and cashews soaked in a hint of rum. The rich an aromatic flavors infuse with the warm and aromatic flavor of christmas , making it a perfect treat for celebrations.

title: Lemon Curd Cake
description: This delightful two-layer sponge cake prepares you for the perfect balance of tangy and sweet. The lemon zest infuses every bite with a bright and zesty flavour, while the whipped cream and lemon curd add a creamy, indulgent touch.

title: Forest Berry Cake
description: Savour the sweet-tangy flavour of our berry cake, made with a moist vanilla sponge and filled with a mixture of fresh berries. The juicy berries paired with our homemade cream cheese frosting creates an explosion of flavours in your mouth!

title: Rainbow Cake
description: This cake is ideal for special events, with its layers of vanilla batter in a rainbow pattern of red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple. It's topped off with whipped cream and sprinkles for a festive touch.

title: Lychee & Almond Cake
description: A delightful dessert - it blends lychee's sweetness and floral flavour with the nuttiness of almonds. This treat features a classic vanilla sponge base topped with fresh lychee, sliced almonds, and whipped cream for a perfect balance of flavours.

title: Fig & Honey Cake
description: Indulge in this decadent cake, topped with juicy fig slices and flavoured with honey. Finished with a sprinkle of candied walnuts and a drizzle of honey, this simple yet stunning cake is sure to please your palate.

title: Magic Chocolate Cake
description: Experience the magic of our delectable Magic Chocolate Cake. Featuring a rich and velvety chocolate flavour and a moist, fluffy texture, this cake will captivate your taste buds with its enchanting taste. The key to its magic is the premium cocoa powder and chocolate ganache, delivering an intense chocolate flavour that will leave you spellbound.

title: Dutch Chocolate Cake
description: Savour the rich and indulgent taste of our chocolate and vanilla cake. This cake boasts a moist texture and intense chocolate flavour, frosted with layers of homemade chocolate cream and ganache. At its centre is a soft vanilla layer filled with whipped cream, offering a perfect balance of chocolate and vanilla in every bite. Perfect for those who crave both chocolate and vanilla, this cake is sure to satisfy.

title: Ferrero Rocher Cake
description: This irresistible treat features three layers of super-moist chocolate hazelnut cake, filled with a rich chocolate hazelnut ganache studded with chopped hazelnuts. The cake is finished with the addition of Ferrero Rocher candies, creating a truly indulgent dessert. Get ready to be swept away by its irresistible flavours and textures.

title: Chocolate Sensation Cake
description: This cake features a vanilla sponge sandwiched between two moist chocolate sponge layers, filled with rich homemade chocolate and vanilla cream infused with authentic apricot jam. The cake is finished with a sprinkle of chocolate flakes, making it a one-of-a-kind dessert experience.

title: German Black Forest Cake
description: A true classic in every sense, this German Gateau has layers of chocolate & vanilla sponge filled with whipping cream, sweet-tart cherries garnished with chocolate shavings.

title: Double Chocolate Mousse Cake
description: Indulge in pure chocolate heaven with our decadent Double Chocolate Mousse Cake. Made with a rich, dark chocolate sponge and layered with a silky chocolate mousse, this cake is sure to satisfy any chocolate lover's cravings. The light & fluffy chocolate mousse is covered in a layer of smooth chocolate ganache, adding an extra layer of decadence.

title: Hide and Seek Mousse Cake
description: Indulge in the decadent layers of our Hide & Seek Biscuit Base Chocolate Mousse Cake. A chocolatey biscuit base serves as the foundation for the velvety smooth chocolate mousse filling, dusted with rich cocoa powder. Each bite is a delightful blend of textures and flavours, making this cake a must-try for any chocolate lover.

title: Oreo Chocolate Cake
description: A favourite among Oreo lovers, the cake comprises layers of moist chocolate sponge filled with decadent Oreo buttercream frosting, Oreo cookies, and crushed Oreos. The cake is carefully crafted to feed your Oreo craving.

title: Salted Caramel Cheesecake
description: Made with the finest cream cheese, this cheesecake boasts a smooth and indulgent texture. It offers the perfect balance of sweet and savoury flavours topped with a generous serving of our signature homemade salted caramel spread.

title: Berries Cheesecake
description: Indulge in a deliciously creamy cheesecake baked using the highest quality cream cheese and topped with a compote of blueberries, raspberries, strawberries, and blackberries.

title: New York Cheesecake
description: Made with the finest cream cheese and baked with love, this cake boasts a dense and creamy texture. Its rich and tangy flavour is a testament to the care and attention put into every bite, making it a timeless classic.

title: Lotus Biscoff Cheesecake
description: Baked with the highest quality cream cheese, a delicious creamy texture, and a generous portion of the famous Lotus Biscoff spread, this cake will leave you asking for more.

title: Oreo Cheesecake
description: Made with the highest quality cream cheese, the cheesecake has a delicious creamy texture. Its Oreo cookie base and crushed Oreos topping, bring a rich chocolate flavor.

title: Chocolate Cheesecake
description: Made with the finest cream cheese and pure chocolate, this cheesecake boasts a rich and dense texture. Each bite is a symphony of creamy and chocolatey goodness.

title: Red Velvet Cheesecake
description: Celebrate any occasion with our unique and delicious Red Velvet Cheesecake. It's made with a moist red velvet sponge and filled with cream cheese icing infused with mixed fruit jam. This irresistible cake is a favourite among many and is sure to impress.

title: Strawberry Cake
description: Treat yourself to the taste of fresh, juicy strawberries with our mouth-watering Strawberry Cake. Made with layers of moist vanilla cake, a sweet strawberry filling and topped with fresh strawberries, this dessert is the perfect balance of flavours. The cake is covered in light and fluffy whipped cream, complementing the tart strawberries.
